# Third-party room assets

All four source assets are released by Poly Haven under **CC0-1.0**:
https://polyhaven.com/license

| Asset | Creator | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Modern Arm Chair 01 | See `modern_arm_chair_01/source.json` | https://polyhaven.com/a/modern_arm_chair_01 |
| Modern Coffee Table 02 | See `modern_coffee_table_02/source.json` | https://polyhaven.com/a/modern_coffee_table_02 |
| Desk Lamp Arm 01 | See `desk_lamp_arm_01/source.json` | https://polyhaven.com/a/desk_lamp_arm_01 |
| Potted Plant 02 | See `potted_plant_02/source.json` | https://polyhaven.com/a/potted_plant_02 |

Each source record preserves author names, exact download URLs, upstream MD5,
local SHA-256, resolution and retrieval date. The fetcher verifies every file.
The room export reduces selected mesh density, fits the original furniture to
VELNEST's room coordinates and downsamples runtime textures to 512 px. The
editable Blender file packs the textures; the source downloads remain here.

Poly Haven's live API was used only during authoring. No API or third-party
asset-host request is made by the shipped application. Powered by Poly Haven.

NVIDIA SimReady was researched but no NVIDIA model is bundled. It was not
treated as universally open source or CC0; dataset licenses vary.
